marketing.faq1Q: How does the prize wheel work?
marketing.faq1A: Customers scan a QR code in your venue. They complete the steps you configured (Google review, social follow, TripAdvisor, etc.), then spin for a prize you defined.
marketing.faq2Q: How fast will I see results?
marketing.faq2A: Many businesses get their first reviews the same day. Your CRM dashboard tracks spins, contacts, and Google review counts.
marketing.faq3A: Google reviews, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and TripAdvisor. You choose which steps appear and in what order.
marketing.faq4Q: How do I set it up?
marketing.faq4A: Sign up online, configure your wheel, prizes, and branding, download your QR, and place it in-store. You can go live in under 10 minutes.
